level_rationale: Per the brief's rules for this battle: no party lost, so nothing is reduced; a party (Trick Room) won with 1 faint, so the composition tweak is proposed below, not applied. Levels untouched; the teams file was not edited.

proposed_tweaks_not_applied: Stop Trick Room and Perish Song alike: give Tornadus Taunt in place of Protect (Prankster Taunt on the setter turn 1 beats Cresselia/Hatterene Trick Room and Gengar Perish Song; the empty-Protect ledger shows Protect is its least valuable slot). Rain Dance retake and Tailwind stay.

Stop the physical Kyogre answers (Bulu Wood Hammer, Iron Hands Wild Charge, Grassy Glide): Kyogre's 132/0/0/252/0/124 spread leaves 90 base Defence naked; 252 HP / 4 Def would not save it, but a 0-Speed-IV Kyogre that moves last under its own Tailwind is not the answer either - the real fix is AI D1 so Wide Guard leads eat Ice Beam/Thunder instead of blanked Spouts.

Stop Urshifu: nothing on the team is bulky on the physical side except Magearna; a Covert Cloak does not stop Unseen Fist. Accept it - Choice Band Urshifu in their own rain is the strongest legal answer and it still cost three faints.

Give the genies 252 HP instead of 4: Tornadus/Thundurus/Landorus each died to one Ice attack in every game (Icicle Crash, Ice Punch, Ice Shard); Life Orb Modest 4 HP legends at L102 are the softest bodies in the fight.
verdict: Beatable by every named line; not yet the hardest fight in the game by the evidence of this session. Four distinct optimized post-game parties went 4-0: Wide Guard + AV Tapu Bulu (won 6-3, 9 turns), Trick Room with Booster Iron Hands and AV Melmetal (won 6-1, 11 turns; 6-0 without a Bleakwind crit), Shadow Tag Perish Song behind Hitmontop Wide Guard (won 6-3, 12 turns), priority hyper-offense with Choice Band Urshifu (won 6-3, 11 turns). What beat it, exactly: (1) Primal Kyogre's 90 base Defence - AV Tapu Bulu Wood Hammer OHKO'd it from full on turn 1, Booster Iron Hands Wild Charge OHKO'd it under Trick Room, and Fake Out chip + Grassy Glide + Thunderclap killed it turn 3; Water Spout never dealt a point of damage in four games. (2) Wide Guard blanks its whole spread arsenal and the AI never adapts (defect D1). (3) An all-fast team is a Trick Room team's dream; Tornadus's Tailwind is a liability there and it spent three turns on empty Protects. (4) Life Orb 4-HP genies die to any Ice attack, so Chien-Pao / Ice Punch Melmetal / Ice Shard clear the middle for free. (5) Unseen Fist Surging Strikes in their own heavy rain OHKOs every non-Kyogre member through Protect and through Calm Mind. The AI did show real reads (Protect on KO turns, two smart switches), and three of the four wins cost three faints, so the fight is a serious one - but a competent Trick Room player loses one Pokemon to a crit and nothing else.
